We have come to a far-off land, to a Scythian path, into an untrodden wilderness. Hephaestus, you must heed the commands your father laid upon you.
For you two, the command of Zeus has its fulfillment, and nothing hinders it any longer; but I am without daring—
You are bold and do not relent in your bitter sufferings, but you speak too freely.
Some wishing to cast Cronus from his throne, so that Zeus might rule, forsooth, while others were eager for the opposite—
But let us put these things aside, and seek some release from your toil.
Do not lament your present woes, but go to the ground—
One fate, but another raises a three-pronged fork.
